privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Component repositories are read, never written.
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption
title: Add openbando to the solution and write the domain map
goal: openbando is a solution component and docs/DOMAINS.md maps every project's domains and the shared ones
acceptance: openbando is in .solution.json with an unused emoji, and npm run check:solution reads its backlog
docs/DOMAINS.md lists each component's modules with code links, the shared domains with who has or needs them, and the extraction rule
docs/agents/gap-review.md tells the reviewer to read the page

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: one manifest entry, one page read from six repositories, one procedure line. Not a measurement.
